The Local Operating Procedure LOP49 requires locking off of shower facilities at night such that prisoners would only have access to toilet facilities. Locking shower facilities could reduce access to possible ligature points. There is some work being undertaken to address the issues that many sanitation room doors cannot be locked but there appears to be no specific timescale or urgency to the implementation of this proposal.
